chapter: Countess Johnson's band and the Kansas City scene
title: Countess Johnson's later years and a possible Billie Holiday record
summary: She left to replace Mary Lou with Kirk, died soon after; Ramey believes she recorded with Billie Holiday.

bands.name: Andy Kirk and His Clouds of Joy

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
